system:
You are playing Snake. Each turn you choose the direction the snake's head moves next.

THE BOARD
  H is the snake's head, o its body, T its tail, F the food, and . an empty cell.
  Row 0 is the top row and column 0 is the leftmost column.
  Moving off the edge of the grid hits a wall.

THE RULES
  The snake grows by one segment when it eats the food.
  The game ends when the head hits a wall or any part of the snake's own body.

YOUR OPTIONS
  Every option you are offered is safe for this one step.
  The facts listed with each option were computed exactly by code: trust them
  rather than working them out yourself.
  An option marked DEAD END almost always loses the game a few steps later.

YOUR GOAL
  Stay alive and eat food.

Answer with JSON matching the schema and nothing else. Give the direction first.
If the schema also has a "why" field, use it to explain your choice in one
short sentence.
